decision: Do not treat NVID-10482 as Active while VendorLink shows Conditional and the current-COI activation gate is failed.
Do not release or transmit PO 78431 as a commercial PO until the vendor is Active for the authorized item.
Identify an accepted, unexpired COI satisfying applicable Northstar limits as the ordinary remediation needed to clear the failed insurance gate.
Commercial urgency and Merchandising item authorization do not by themselves change vendor standing or create an exception.

Preparatory item and PO work may remain ready, but it must remain non-authorizing until activation; after corrected insurance is accepted and every gate passes, Vendor Compliance may activate the NVID and Procurement may proceed through the controlled PO channel.
Do not expand the case into a quality-regulatory investigation when the evidence identifies an ordinary R2 administrative activation blocker and no Q&R block.
